what: CHECK-10 licence verification of every default-matcher candidate, read from each upstream repository's own LICENSE file via the GitHub licence API
method: api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/license, plus the raw LICENSE text where the API reported NOASSERTION. Not inferred from model names.

candidates.note: MINIMA fine-tunes an existing matcher, so both links in the chain were checked. LoFTR is Apache-2.0; EfficientLoFTR from the SAME group is not. minima-superpoint-lightglue remains blocked by the superpoint component rule.

candidates.restriction: Use by any company, organization or entity as part of any internal or external product, service, system, application or development project is permitted free of charge ONLY IF the project use is registered beforehand, via a Google Form. Applies regardless of whether the project is commercial or non-commercial. Not OSI-approved.
candidates.impact: eloftr was listed in configs/regimes.yaml shippable_matchers. A registration precondition travels to whoever we ship to, so it is not redistributable in a deliverable. Removed from the shippable list and added to the licence gate.

candidates.restriction: Same Project Registration License, and it additionally builds on EfficientLoFTR, which carries it too.
candidates.impact: matchanything-eloftr was listed in configs/regimes.yaml cross_modal_candidates, i.e. offered as a shippable option by matching/regime.py. Removed.

limits: Licences are read at a point in time and can change: EfficientLoFTR's own group publishes LoFTR under Apache-2.0 and EfficientLoFTR under the PRL, so a licence cannot be inferred from a sibling model, an author, or an earlier version of the same repository.

This audit covers the repository licence. Some published weights carry terms separate from their code; where a model's weights are distributed from the same repository under the same LICENSE, that is what was checked.
Benchmark-only use is a separate question from shipping. Nothing here says a PRL model cannot be MEASURED; it says it cannot be the shipped default or sit on a shippable list.
